parsed.refutation_attempt: The printf call on line 11 uses a compile‑time constant format string "Value: %" PRId64 "\n". The user‑supplied value is passed as the second argument to printf, not as part of the format string. Therefore there is no format string vulnerability, and consequently no possibility of OS command injection via this printf. No other code in the fragment invokes a shell or interprets the value as a command. The source of untrusted data (stdin via scanf) is correctly validated by scanf and is not used in a dangerous operation.
